prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1491; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck and low back pain and stiffness. Over the course of 16 visits, care consisted of conservative management including manual therapy, stretching and strengthening exercises, and modalities for pain control. Reported symptoms are consistent with the mechanism and force of the impact described. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced range of motion in the cervical and lumbar regions, while neurological screening, reflexes, and strength testing were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the neck or back is known. Treatment progressed in a typical fashion, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered without duplication. The patient is improving and is expected to reach maximum benefit with a home exercise program.
